verification.notes: Primary Daily Wire material and the tribute-show transcript confirm that Matt Walsh, Ben Shapiro, and Michael Knowles jointly hosted The Charlie Kirk Show on September 16, 2025, after Daily Wire leadership offered assistance. The assertion that Walsh alone was requested and that Daily Wire imposed Shapiro’s inclusion as a condition is publicly documented only through Candace Owens and derivative coverage; no internal communication or independent confirmation was found. The resulting show is verified, while the alleged condition remains uncorroborated.
